findings.text: Buffered read service that first tries a lockless fast path and then falls back to batched retrieval. It rejects negative positions, stops at filesystem maximum and empty iterators, truncates length to the maximum, accumulates partial success across batches, updates position and iterator progress, refreshes access metadata and readahead history, and returns bytes moved when any succeeded.

Top level read dispatcher that ignores empty requests without touching access time, synchronizes pending writeback before direct access, invokes the mapping direct operation, advances position on success, restores unconsumed iterator state unless completion is queued asynchronously, and otherwise continues with buffered handling for remainders except for error, full satisfaction, DAX, or end of file.

Splice read variant that caps requested length by free pipe capacity measured in pages, builds synchronous control state at the supplied offset, repeatedly fetches uptodate batches and samples size afterwards, marks use and maintains aliasing caches, moves folio slices into pipe buffers while advancing offsets and history, and returns bytes moved when any succeeded.

Hole versus data locator over a caller interval that walks present entries under protection, treats gaps as decisive for the complementary kind, rounds each entry extent up to its natural size, delegates intra folio block status to a helper, balances references on examined entries, and reports interval end or missing data with dedicated outcomes.

Range invalidation that skips empty mappings, gathers batches of entries up to an inclusive end, handles exceptional values with DAX synchronization and shadow clearing, unmaps mapped contents once per sweep before locking, verifies ownership after locking, waits for writeback completion, attempts per folio unmap and invalidate while accumulating errors, and performs a final DAX table zap.

Write synchronization plus invalidation helpers where nonblocking mode fails fast when writeback is needed or pages are present, blocking mode waits for the byte interval to become stable, and invalidation of the corresponding index interval happens before the data operation so queued direct results are preserved.

Small utilities where one slices a folio at a file offset into page sized pipe records with page cache operations and acquired references until size is exhausted or the pipe fills, another applies per page cache maintenance across every constituent page of a folio, and a third unmaps an index interval with saturation on overflow while holding the mapping lock shared only when mapped.

Fast path eligibility requires valid contents and absence of readahead and drop behind markers. A request staying inside the page that held the previous end is always eligible. Otherwise eligibility mirrors hotness that would leave access state unchanged, expressed either through generation aware reference bits or through classic referenced, idle, active and unevictable combinations.

Lockless batch copying declines when cache maintenance may be required and writable mappings exist, disables faults inside the protected section, bounds each sweep to a fixed batch size, validates identity through free for RCU indication plus ordered slot reloads separated by barriers, samples size only after validity is established, copies within one page bounded by iterator and file size, and records progress per page.

Locality handling marks the current folio hot when the request continues inside the folio holding the previous end, otherwise it applies the generic access marker and propagates the hot outcome. Drop behind cleanup acts only when flagged and neither dirty nor under writeback, and only when the folio lock is immediately available, releasing afterwards.

Inner hole and data probing treats exceptional entries and fully valid folios as decisive without further work. When block granularity probing is supported it drops protection, locks the folio, rechecks ownership, aligns the start down to block size, and scans block by block until the wanted kind appears or the folio ends. Exceptional size scales with entry order while folio size comes from the folio itself.

Invalidation never holds the mapping tree lock across folio work. It takes that lock shared only around the tree walk, locks each folio individually, abandons entries whose ownership changed, waits for writeback while holding the folio lock, releases before batch cleanup, and yields scheduling between batches.

Fault folio acquisition prefers immediate success, honors a no wait retry request by returning without blocking while keeping fault state held, otherwise pins the file and releases the fault lock only on the first retryable attempt, then waits interruptibly or uninterruptibly according to killability, releasing the fault lock on killable interruption when no pin was taken.

Fast read driver starts from the page holding the prior end or an empty marker, repeatedly invokes bounded batches accumulating copied bytes and last index, checks for fatal signals between batches and yields scheduling, and stops when a batch reports completion.

Slow read loop yields each iteration, converts queued asynchronous intent to nonblocking after partial success, stops at current size, fetches a batch, recomputes size and end, skips folios starting beyond end, fails the iteration on short user copy, always runs drop behind handling and releases references and reinitializes the batch before continuing while data remains and no error occurred.

Lockless copying must not trigger faults that could sleep, must not use hardened user copy that dereferences compound state across a possible split, must order flag, slot and contents observations to cope with reuse of the same memory as tail or unrelated contents, and must avoid cache maintenance that writes folio state without a reference.

Buffered paths sample writable mapping state once per batch before copying, flush aliasing caches on the kernel side when needed, and always sample size after establishing validity so zero fill beyond end is not exposed unless concurrent extension legitimately made it visible. Invalidation unmaps before locking to avoid ordering hazards.

Per page splice output record carries page cache pipe operations together with target page, offset within the page, and length of the slice. The pipe head advances once per filled record and the intra page offset resets after the first page of a folio slice.
Threshold constant known as MMAP_LOTSAMISS has numeric value one hundred.

Externally reachable read and query entries comprise the generic read dispatcher, the buffered read service, the splice read service, and the hole and data locator, plus range invalidation and write synchronization helpers used around direct and buffered operations.
